GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT
Public Services - Human Resources - General Transfers 2019 - Extension of the period of
relaxation of ban on transfers - Amendment - Orders - Issued.
FINANCE (HR.I-PLG. & POLICY) DEPARTMENT
Dated: 28-06-2019
G.O.Ms.No.71
Read the following:
1. G.O.Ms.No.62, Finance (HR.I-Plg. & Policy) Department, Dt. 14-06-2019.
***
ORDER:
1. In the G.O. read above, Government have issued guidelines for general transfers for the
year 2019 and relaxed the ban on transfers from 15-06-2019 to 30-06-2019.
2. Several Departments have represented that, on account of the large number of requests
received, the process could not be completed within the stipulated time.
3. Government, after careful examination, hereby issue the following amendment to the G.O.
read above:
AMENDMENT
4. In para 2(i) of the G.O. read above, for the words and figures "30-06-2019", the words and
figures "10-07-2019" shall be substituted; and in para 3, for "01-07-2019", read "11-07-2019".
5. All other conditions stipulated in the G.O. read above shall remain unaltered.
(BY ORDER AND IN THE NAME OF THE GOVERNOR OF ANDHRA PRADESH)
D. KALYANI
PRINCIPAL SECRETARY TO GOVERNMENT
To
All Departments of Secretariat.
All Heads of Departments.
All District Collectors.
The Director of Treasuries and Accounts, A.P.
The Pay and Accounts Officer, A.P.
Copy to:
PS to Principal Secretary (Finance).
//FORWARDED :: BY ORDER//
SECTION OFFICER
